payload.core_mechanism_summary: Check 3 candidate slopes from first three points; for each, group points by their y - slope*x value and require exactly two groups.
payload.rationale: The solution enumerates all plausible slopes from the first three points (pigeonhole principle) and verifies if all points can be covered by two lines with that slope. No recursion, but it is a complete search over a small space, fitting backtracking subtype by elimination.
